title: Radio Replay: What's In It For Me?

sentences.en: Have you ever had the experience of going to a party or office get-together
sentences.zh: 你有没有过这种经历：去参加派对或办公室聚会，

sentences.en: and meeting someone with the same name, the same birthday?
sentences.zh: 结果遇到了一个跟你同名同姓、甚至同年同月同日生的人？

sentences.en: Maybe you've gone on vacation to some far-flung locale
sentences.zh: 也许你去某个遥远的地方度假，

sentences.en: and met someone who lives down the street from you.
sentences.zh: 却碰巧遇到了一个就住在你家街区的人。

sentences.en: Many of us are drawn to coincidences like this.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人都对这样的巧合情有独钟。

sentences.en: They make us wonder, how in the world did that happen?
sentences.zh: 它们让我们不禁好奇：这到底是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Today we explore our deep fascination with these moments of serendipity.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将探讨人们对这些机缘巧合时刻的深深迷恋。

sentences.en: New research suggests they reveal important things about how our minds work
sentences.zh: 最新研究表明，它们揭示了关于我们大脑运作方式的重要秘密，

sentences.en: and they have a far more powerful effect on our lives than most of us imagine.
sentences.zh: 而且它们对我们生活的影响，远比我们想象的要强大得多。

sentences.en: A couple of months ago, we asked Hidden Brain listeners
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我们邀请《隐藏的大脑》的听众们，

sentences.en: to share coincidences that they'd experienced.
sentences.zh: 分享他们经历过的巧合。

sentences.en: Lots of people called in with amazing stories.
sentences.zh: 许多人打电话来讲述了惊人的故事。

sentences.en: Within those stories, we found two that themselves formed a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 在这些故事中，我们发现了两个本身就能构成巧合的故事。

sentences.en: So I was a student at the University of Rhode Island
sentences.zh: 当时我是罗德岛大学的一名学生，

sentences.en: and we were in this writing class.
sentences.zh: 我们正在上这门写作课。

sentences.en: She was talking to the teacher of her writing class
sentences.zh: 她当时正在和写作课的老师聊天，

sentences.en: and the teacher mentioned that she lived in a small town in Vermont.
sentences.zh: 老师提到她住在佛蒙特州的一个小镇上。

sentences.en: The same small town, it turned out, where Amanda's mother had grown up.
sentences.zh: 而那个小镇，后来证明正是阿曼达的母亲长大的地方。

sentences.en: The teacher asked Amanda what her mother's maiden name was
sentences.zh: 老师问阿曼达她母亲的娘家姓是什么，

sentences.en: And she just kind of drops her pen and she goes,

but I live in the house where your mother grew up.

sentences.zh: 另一位给我们打电话的听众是莎拉·托佩罗夫。

sentences.en: She called us on a scratchy phone line from Paris.
sentences.zh: 她通过一条杂音很重的电话线从巴黎打来电话。

sentences.en: Sarah's an American, but has been living in France for several years.
